title: W-1 gate: skip the hosted macOS verify job explicitly while ward-cli is private, require it once public
description: DEC-253 (a2) (opum-doc ODOC-552 note, opum-ai/opum-doc#1542): dec-14tajwo was answered B, no billed macOS minutes. While ward-cli is private the W-1 gate is the install runbook local codesign --verify --strict on the Mac before the tag; the hosted macos-14 verify job from WCLI-96 (#224, #226) must not queue a billed run while private and the release must not wait on it. Gate it explicitly on the repository being public, so it neither silently blocks nor silently passes; after the flip it runs again, release requires it again, and the local step stays as a second check. No self-hosted macOS runner. Follow-up of WCLI-96, which keeps AC1 and AC5.

acceptanceCriteria.text: While the repository is private, the verify job resolves to no hosted macOS runner and states in its log that the gate was skipped and why, and the release job is not blocked by it
Once the repository is public, the same job runs codesign --verify --strict --verbose=2 on macos-14 and the release job requires its success
A test proves the gate both ways: the private case skips and the public case requires, and a missing repository visibility fails closed to the public case
The reject-path proof (a Linux-built artifact failing codesign --verify --strict on the Mac) is recorded on WCLI-96

implementationNotes: Landed as ward-cli#228, squash 7d8484c1c012fb957aea42469dcae8feb1b7a86c (head 766471fb2337a61272cdba9a3b900d4f7490867e, Check, Docs and Tracker integrity green). Review: unit ward-cli-review-228, claude-opus-5-5, APPROVE at 766471f, with 4 non-blocking findings (relay by team-lead, not the unit message); the findings are filed as WCLI-121, which blocks the public flip and is not started. AC3 ticked: test/release-workflow.test.ts evaluates the workflow own runs-on and step if expressions and shows private skips (self-hosted Linux, notice only), public requires (macos-14, download and strict codesign), and a missing, null or string-valued private field takes the verifying path; six mutations each turned only the predicted tests red. AC4 ticked: the reject-path proof is recorded on WCLI-96 (Linux-built v0.1.0 artifact, exit 1, invalid signature). AC1 and AC2 stay OPEN because their evidence so far is static and each needs an observed run: AC1 at the first private tag or dispatch run (the notice in the log, and no macOS job queued), AC2 after the public flip. `github.event.repository.private` in the push and workflow_dispatch payloads is documented but unmeasured; a missing field would take the macos-14 path and queue one billed run, a cost exception to dec-14tajwo B.

DEC-253 (a3), opum-doc 2026-11-01 15:46Z: the verify job PUBLIC arm moves from macos-14 to macos-15 because GitHub retires macos-14 on 2026-11-02. The task text above (AC2 and notes) names macos-14; read macos-15 wherever it does. The arm stays visibility-keyed and no billed macOS minutes run before the flip (dec-14tajwo B). The change is in opum-ai/ward-cli#237, Opus APPROVE at c6d3395.
